bias.zh: 中性 · 回调测试 $490 一带

read.en: Applied Materials slipped 1.9% on Oct 12 to $497.53, down 8% in five sessions. It is below its 5, 10 and 100-day averages ($513–520) but still above the 30-day ($475) and the rising 200-day ($436). Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8, and the MACD histogram has shrunk from 8.6 to 1.6 in three sessions, so a bearish cross is near. RSI is 51.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月12日下跌 1.9%，收于 $497.53，五个交易日下跌 8%。股价位于 5 日、10 日和 100 日均线（$513–520）下方，但仍高于 30 日均线（$475）及上行的 200 日均线（$436）。抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空，MACD 柱体三个交易日内由 8.6 缩至 1.6，接近死叉。RSI 为 51。

read.en: The Oct 12 low of $492 is the first support; below it the 30-day average and late-September shelf near $475 matter most, then $436 (Jul 29 pivot). Overhead, the cluster of averages at $513–520 is the first hurdle, then $542–548, which capped rallies in August and on Oct 2.
read.zh: 10月12日低点 $492 为第一支撑；跌破则关注约 $475 的 30 日均线及9月下旬平台，其次是 $436（7月29日转折点）。上方首个阻碍为 $513–520 的均线密集区，其次 $542–548，该区域曾在8月和10月2日压制反弹。

r.en: Capped rallies in Aug and on Oct 2 ($542–548)
